record.NAME: k_ta_always_overwrite_ta_mode_to_both
record.DESCRIPTION: If any alert is raised, set TA mode to BOTH (dont distinguish between front/rear for qualifications).

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_qualifying_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of cycle to qualify an alert level.

record.NAME: k_ta_f_only_allow_consecutive_ttc_based_alert_levels
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag to only allow consecutive alerts. Applies to alert levels 3 and higher.

record.NAME: k_ta_f_skip_holding_for_single_alert_level_drop
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag to skip alert level holding if the drop is only to one level lower. Only affects drop from level 4.

record.NAME: k_ta_f_only_allow_ttc_based_alert_level_for_mature_obj
record.DESCRIPTION: Flag to only allow TTC based alerts for tracker objects with status MATURE. Applies to alert levels 2 and higher.

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_holding_cycles
record.DESCRIPTION: Number of cycle for holding an alert level.

record.NAME: k_ta_prediction_steps_max
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum number of steps to predict trajectories of the ego and the relevant objects.

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_lvl_1_ttp_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: TA raises an alert level 1 for an object with a calculated TTP smaller than or equal to the specified value based on alert trigger sensitivity [EARLY NORMAL LATE].

record.NAME: k_ta_active_obj_ttp_offset
record.DESCRIPTION: TA raises an alert level 1 for a previously active object with a calculated TTP smaller than or equal to k_ta_alert_lvl_1_ttp_threshold plus this specified value.

record.NAME: k_ta_f_apply_ttp_hysteresis_globally
record.DESCRIPTION: If active, k_ta_active_obj_ttp_offset is applied to all objects if a warning is currently raised. By default, k_ta_active_obj_ttp_offset is only applied to the currently warned object.

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_lvl_1_ttp_late_trigger_host_speed_max
record.DESCRIPTION: TA uses the late alert trigger below the specified vehicle host speed.

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_lvl_1_ttp_normal_trigger_host_speed_max
record.DESCRIPTION: TA uses the normal alert trigger below the specified vehicle host speed. At and above this host speed, the early trigger is used.

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_lvl_2_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: TA raises an alert level 2 for an object with a calculated TTC smaller than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_lvl_3_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: TA raises an alert level 3 for an object with a calculated TTC smaller than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_lvl_3_ttb_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: TA raises an alert level 3 only for an object with a calculated TTB (time-to-brake) smaller than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_lvl_4_ttc_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: TA raises an alert level 4 for an object with a calculated TTC smaller than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ta_alert_lvl_4_decel_threshold
record.DESCRIPTION: TA raises an alert level 4 for an object with an estimated host deceleration to avoid a collision greater than or equal to the specified value.

record.NAME: k_ta_critical_approach_min_safe_distance
record.DESCRIPTION: TA considers an approach of an object to the ego with a distance smaller than the specified value as a collision.

record.NAME: k_ta_critical_approach_angle_diff_min
record.DESCRIPTION: TA considers an approach of an object to the ego only as critical above this angle difference.

record.NAME: k_ta_critical_approach_check_ego_circles
record.DESCRIPTION: TA only checks the enabled ego circle path predictions. [front middle rear].

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_max_pred_yaw_angle
record.DESCRIPTION: TA only continues the ego trajectory calculation if the (absolute) predicted yaw angle to the last straight section is below this threshold.

record.NAME: k_ta_obj_pred_speed_min
record.DESCRIPTION: TA only continues object trajectory calculation if the predicted waypoint speed is equal or above this threshold.

record.NAME: k_ta_obj_acceleration_long_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor controls the influence of the acceleration value for the object in long direction.

record.NAME: k_ta_obj_acceleration_lat_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor controls the influence of the acceleration value for the object in lat direction.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_shape_gain_per_pred_step
record.DESCRIPTION: TA grows or shrinks an object's shape by multiplying the specified value with the object's dimensions at every prediction step. This means, the more in the future a prediction step is, the more the shape will be grown or shrunk. This is in addition to the fixed gain specified by k_ego_shape_gain_fixed. Value greater than 1: ego shape will grow, value lower than 1: ego shape will shrink

record.NAME: k_ta_obj_shape_gain_per_pred_step
record.DESCRIPTION: TA grows or shrinks the ego shape by multiplying the specified value with the ego dimensions at every prediction step. This means, the more in the future a prediction step is, the more the shape will be grown or shrunk. This is in addition to the fixed gain specified by k_obj_shape_gain_fixed. Value greater than 1: object shape will grow, value lower than 1: object shape will shrink

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_shape_gain_fixed
record.DESCRIPTION: TA grows or shrinks the ego shape by multiplying the specified value with the ego dimensions once at the beginning of the prediction phase. Value greater than 1: ego shape will be increased, value lower than 1: ego shape will be decreased

record.NAME: k_ta_obj_shape_gain_fixed
record.DESCRIPTION: TA grows or shrinks an object's shape by multiplying the specified value with the object's dimensions once at the beginning of the prediction phase. Value greater than 1: object shape will be increased, value lower than 1: object shape will be decreased

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: TA only marks objects as relevant for ego vehicle in the specified speed range.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_speed_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: TA adds these offsets to k_ta_ego_speed for objects that have been active previously.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_yawrate
record.DESCRIPTION: TA only marks objects as relevant for an absolute ego yawrate in the specified range.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_yawrate_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: TA adds this offset to k_ta_ego_yawrate for objects that have been active previously.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_long_acceleration
record.DESCRIPTION: TA only marks objects as relevant for an ego acceleration in the specified range.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_long_acceleration_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: TA adds this offset to k_ta_ego_long_acceleration for objects that have been active previously.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_acceleration_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor controls the influence of the positive acceleration value on the predicted velocity in each prediction step.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_deceleration_weight
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor controls the influence of the negative acceleration / deceleration value on the predicted velocity in each prediction step.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_pred_const_velocity_pred_steps_min
record.DESCRIPTION: This value indicates at which prediction step to switch to a constant velocity prediction model when TA alert level 4 was active in previous cycle.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_circle_offset
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor adds an additional offset to the host circles.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_circle_host_length_factor
record.DESCRIPTION: This weight factor controls the influence of the host vehicle length when calculating the host vehicle circle offsets.

record.NAME: k_ta_ego_yawangle_integration_yawrate_min
record.DESCRIPTION: This value indicates the minimum (absolute) yawrate value to start integrating the ego yawangle. Below this threshold the yawangle resets.

record.NAME: k_f_ta_enable_debug_mode
record.DESCRIPTION: TA uses this flag in order to turn on/off the debug mode which enables object position manipulation.

record.NAME: k_f_fta_enable
record.DESCRIPTION: TA uses this flag in order to turn on/off the FTA subfunction.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_exist_prblty
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA puts only objects with an existence probability in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_exist_prblty_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with an existence probability outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_exist_prblty entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vcs_long_vel_rel
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA adds only objects with a relative vcs long velocity in the specified value range to its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vcs_long_vel_rel_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with a relative vcs long velocity outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_vcs_long_vel_rel entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vcs_lat_vel_rel
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA adds only objects with a relative vcs lat velocity in the specified value range to its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vcs_lat_vel_rel_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with a relative vcs lat velocity outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_vcs_lat_vel_rel entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vcs_long_vel
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA adds only objects with a vcs long velocity in the specified value range to its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vcs_long_vel_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with a vcs long velocity outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_vcs_long_vel_rel entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vcs_lat_vel
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with a vcs lat velocity in the specified value range to its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vcs_lat_vel_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with a vcs lat velocity outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_vcs_lat_vel_rel entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_ta_straight_host_curvature_max
record.DESCRIPTION: For TA to assume that the host vehicle is driving straight, the host curvature is must be lower than this parameter.

record.NAME: k_ta_lookup_turning_host_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: This host speed parameter configures the lookup table for the host turning logic depending on curvature.

record.NAME: k_ta_lookup_turning_host_curvature_min
record.DESCRIPTION: For TA to assume that the host vehicle is turning, the host curvature is must be greater than this lookup parameter depending on host vehicle speed set in k_ta_lookup_turning_host_speed.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vcs_long_pos_straight_min
record.DESCRIPTION: In straight scenarios, FTA only adds objects that are generally positioned in front of the host vehicle to its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_heading
record.DESCRIPTION: In curved scenarios, FTA only adds objects with an absolute heading in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_heading_straight
record.DESCRIPTION: In straight scenarios, FTA only adds objects with an absolute heading in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_heading_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with an absolute heading outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_heading entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_heading_rate
record.DESCRIPTION: In turning scenarios, FTA only adds objects with an absolute heading rate in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_heading_rate_straight
record.DESCRIPTION: In straight scenarios, FTA only adds objects with an absolute heading rate in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_heading_rate_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with an absolute heading rate outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_heading_rate entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with a speed in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_speed_straight
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with a speed in the specified value range on its list of active objects when driving straight.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_speed_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with a speed outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_speed entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_length
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with a length in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_length_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with a length outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_length entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_width
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with a width in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_width_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with a width outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_width entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_area
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with an area in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_area_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with an area outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_area entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vru_class_prob
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with a VRU class probability in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_vru_class_prob_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with a VRU class probability outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_vru_class_prob entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_age_min
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with an object age greater than the specified threshold on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_ego_obj_heading_diff
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with an absolute heading difference to the turning host vehicle in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_ego_obj_heading_diff_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with an absolute heading difference to the turning host vehicle outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_ego_obj_heading_diff entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_eclipse_value
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA only adds objects with an eclipse value in the specified value range on its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_eclipse_value_ofst
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with an eclipse value outside of the sum of the specified values and k_fta_obj_eclipse_value entries from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_obj_velocity_heading_diff_max
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA removes objects with a difference of heading and velocity vector based heading greater than the specified threshold from its list of active objects.

record.NAME: k_fta_brake_deceleration_max
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA caps the maximum braking deceleration to this value.

record.NAME: k_fta_brake_dead_time
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA assumes that the vehicle will start deceleration after the specified dead time of the braking system.

record.NAME: k_f_fta_enable_brake_gradient_logic
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA considers the brake gradient or jerk if this flag is enabled. It uses the value from k_fta_brake_gradient.

record.NAME: k_fta_brake_gradient
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA assumes that the vehicle deceleration will ramp up with the specified gradient or jerk. Only active if k_f_fta_enable_brake_gradient_logic is enabled.

record.NAME: k_f_fta_enable_danger_zones
record.DESCRIPTION: FTA uses this flag in order to turn on/off the danger zone area.

record.NAME: k_fta_danger_zone_point_size
record.DESCRIPTION: Sets the number of points used to construct the danger zones.

record.NAME: k_fta_danger_zone_left_long
record.DESCRIPTION: List of long coordinates of danger zone on ego left side.

record.NAME: k_fta_danger_zone_left_lat

record.NAME: k_fta_danger_zone_right_long

record.NAME: k_fta_danger_zone_right_lat

record.NAME: k_pfgs_symbol_request_sides_enabled

record.NAME: k_pfgs_ego_speed
record.DESCRIPTION: PFGS only increases qualification counter for ego vehicle in the specified speed range.

record.NAME: k_pfgs_qualification_counter_fast_obj
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum qualification counter value for PFGS alert and brake request. Threshold will be scaled based on object speed. Value 3 means in third relevant cycle.

record.NAME: k_pfgs_qualification_counter_slow_obj
record.DESCRIPTION: Maximum qualification counter value for PFGS alert and brake request. Threshold will be scaled based on object speed.

record.NAME: k_pfgs_qualification_ttc_min
record.DESCRIPTION: Minimum TTC value of most critical object to start qualification process for PFGS.

record.NAME: k_pfgs_qualification_check_f_stationary
record.DESCRIPTION: Enables the check for f_stationary. If active, only objects that are not stationary can increase the qualification counter.

record.NAME: k_tap_lvl_2_host_curvature_min
record.DESCRIPTION: For TAP warnings of level 2 and higher the host curvature must be greater than this parameter.

record.NAME: k_rta_ttp_obj_abs_lat_vel_rel_max

record.NAME: k_rta_ttp_obj_abs_heading_diff_max
record.DESCRIPTION: RTA only calculates a TTP value for objects that are not heading away from the info zone.

record.NAME: k_rta_ttp_curve_suppression_obj_distance_min
record.DESCRIPTION: RTA only calculates a TTP value when the host vehicle is not driving straight for close objects or objects that have curvi info available.
